our_interpretation: The condition is whether Anthropic faced a real capacity shortage around the time of the post.
'Greed' and 'choosing' are moral judgments and are not graded. The checkable parts are (a) that Anthropic kept adding customers and (b) that it struggled to keep availability above 99% ('two nines').
'Struggles to keep above two nines' is read as measured availability of its main services near or below 99%, not as a requirement that every service fell below 99%.
The period is the roughly 90 days before the post (about February 5 to May 6, 2026), which matches the window Anthropic's status page reports.
criteria.support_condition: Anthropic faced a capacity shortage; its status page showed availability for its main services at or just around 99% in the period; and it reported growing customer numbers in the same period.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Availability for Anthropic's main services was comfortably above 99% (for example 99.9%), or Anthropic was not adding customers in the period.
